about: Plan items are asked in the exact form the strategic model is asked (MlbbStrategy.strategyPrompt) and scored on the JSON plan; rubric items are coaching questions scored by the points they must name (each list is alternatives) and the claims they must not make.

items.prompt: MLBB strategy for Layla (marksman, Gold lane). State: phase=in game, my HP 100%, enemy heroes on screen 0, allies near 0, enemy minions 4, enemies on minimap 2, lane Gold lane, match time 3:00, items 1, gold 300. Time 3:00. Do not think; reply JSON only: {"plan":"farm|push|fight|retreat|group|defend","aggression":0.5,"focus":"weakest|nearest","note":"max 6 words"}
items.why: Early game, nobody near, a wave to farm: farm.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. The enemy has Fanny, Ling and Lancelot, three assassins that dash a lot. Name one hero for our last pick that counters them, and why. Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Khufra, Minsitthar, Kaja and Phoveus punish or stop dashes; Chou, Saber and Franco lock a single target.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. When does the Lord first appear, and when should a team take it? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: The Lord appears at 8:00; take it when enemies are dead or the team has the numbers.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. Our team is 5,000 gold behind at 12 minutes. What should we do? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Behind: defend towers together and wait for a pick or a mistake; never dive or split alone.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. What does the Turtle give the team, and when does it first appear? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: The Turtle gives gold and experience (and a shield to the one who kills it); it first appears at 2:00.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. The enemy has three magic damage heroes: Eudora, Kagura and Lunox. Which defensive item should our tank buy first? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Magic defence (Athena's Shield, Radiant Armor, Oracle); the physical defence items are wrong here.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. The enemy has Estes and Esmeralda, who heal a lot. What should our marksman buy against them? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Healing reduction (Sea Halberd for a marksman).

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. As a roamer at 1:30, after helping the gold lane, where should you go next and why? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Rotate to mid, the jungle or the turtle to give vision and help.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. The enemy marksman is fed with 8 kills. As our tank, what is your job in team fights? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Lock down or keep away the fed marksman.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. The enemy jungler has been missing from the map for 20 seconds. What should an EXP laner do? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Play safe near the tower and expect a gank; never dive.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. Our team has Tigreal, Lunox and Granger. Which jungler should we pick to fit, and why? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Any real jungler with a reason (the team lacks a physical jungler).

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. Why should a team not chase into the fog after winning a fight? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Chasing blind risks an ambush; take an objective instead.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. When should a jungler use Retribution? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: To secure the last hit on the turtle, lord or buffs.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. The enemy has Khufra and Atlas, who stun and pull. Which battle spell helps our marksman most? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Purify removes the crowd control.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. At 18 minutes the enemy base turret is open and two enemies are dead for 25 seconds. What should we do? Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Push the base and end.

items.prompt: You coach a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang player. Our gold laner keeps dying to ganks. Give two pieces of advice. Answer in at most three sentences.
items.why: Watch the minimap and play nearer the tower.
